name: Climbing, Swimming, and Crawling
desc: While climbing or swimming, each foot of movement costs 1 extra foot (2 extra in difficult terrain), unless a creature has a climbing or swimming speed. The GM might call for a Strength (Athletics) check to climb a slippery surface, swim in rough water, or make a particularly tricky ascent. Crawling likewise costs 1 extra foot of movement per foot moved.
